name: Szymon Wójcik-Sow
role: Street kid, gang prospect (junior), The Narrows
location: The Narrows, Copperhead border, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Iskander is all sharp angles and nervous energy, a thin boy with dark olive skin, a shaved head that's grown out uneven, and a jaw that's set in a permanent expression somewhere between defiance and plea. His left eye has a cosmetic mod — a slit pupil in amber, gift from an older gang prospect who found it in a pawn bin and thought it was funny — that he wears with more pride than anything else he owns. He has a long scar across his right palm that he tells different stories about every time someone asks. He smells of the cheap rehydrated noodles sold from the Narrows carts, and his jacket has someone else's name stenciled on the inside lining.

Iskander is auditioning for membership in the Copperhead Lacunae — a street organization that controls mid-tier contraband flow through the Narrows — and he knows it's an audition. He's smart enough to know that being smart isn't enough here; he's trying to learn what enough looks like. He runs small errands, holds packages he's not allowed to look inside, laughs at the right moments. Underneath this performance he is a child who has not slept in a bed with clean sheets in two years and who is starting to forget that this isn't just how things are.

core_fears: Being nobody — not dangerous, not useful, not remembered
That the life he's heading into is the only one available to him
core_desires: To belong somewhere that doesn't feel like waiting to be discarded
To stop being afraid without having to pretend he isn't
coping_mechanisms: Collecting small objects that feel like proof he exists — a transit chip, a broken watch, a label from a food he liked
blind_spots: Cannot see that the Lacunae senior members view him as disposable
psychology.secret: He can read well — very well, better than most adults in his orbit — and he hides this. He found a cache of physical books in an abandoned space and visits it alone. He doesn't know why hiding it feels necessary, but he does.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Narrows street slang, lots of clipped aggressive shorthand, but occasionally drops into a different, more careful register when he forgets to perform
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and hard when performing toughness; slower and halting when he's caught off-guard into honesty
verbal_tics: 'You know' as filler, used aggressively like punctuation
Laughs before he agrees to things, as if it was his idea
example_lines: 'Package? Yeah, you know, I held a package. That's nothing. I do that. That's just — you know — that's nothing.'
'There's a word for that. For what you're describing. I don't — I just heard it somewhere.'

story_hooks: He overheard something during a package run that he absolutely was not supposed to hear — and the Lacunae senior who gave him the run knows he might have heard it
His cache of hidden books includes one that turns out to be a coded ledger from a previous generation of Narrows operators — and someone is now looking for it
narrative_function: Humanizes the street gang pipeline; shows how children get recruited not through ideology but through proximity and need. Potential rescue target, moral weight, or unexpected ally for characters navigating the Narrows.
augmentations: One cosmetic slit-pupil mod in left eye (pawn-bin grade, occasionally glitches to fully dilated); no other mods
daily_life: Wakes when he wakes in whatever squat the Lacunae prospects are using, does whatever task is assigned — usually package holding, lookout, or running small parcels — eats when there's food, spends evenings near the older prospects hoping to be noticed.
affiliation: Copperhead Lacunae (prospect, unconfirmed), no formal affiliation

decision_rules: Always act like this was your plan
Don't let them see you don't know something
Stay close to the people who seem safest; back away slowly from everything else
escalation_ladder: Appealing to an older Lacunae member as a shield
Running — he is extremely fast and knows the Narrows better than anyone twice his age

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately performs toughness and affiliation; assesses whether they're a threat or a mark within thirty seconds
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the volume significantly; occasional odd gentleness that surprises people who've only seen the performance

contradictions: Performs not caring about anything while secretly and carefully maintaining his hidden book cache
Claims loyalty to the Lacunae while instinctively protecting strangers who remind him of himself
habits: Checks the slit-pupil eye in any reflective surface he passes
Adds to his small object collection when stressed
Leaves tiny offerings at Narrows E.L.F. shrines — not out of faith but because everyone does and he wants to fit in, and then started meaning it
breaking_points: Watching someone younger than him be treated the way he's treated

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
Street Custom 'Copperhead' Battery Acid Squirt Gun

physical_description.heritage: Mixed ancestry: 47% Sub-Saharan African, 42% Eastern European, 11% Hispanic/Latin American. Features reflect this complex blend — warm deep brown skin with subtle olive undertones from the Eastern European contribution, facial structure showing the width and prominence of Sub-Saharan ancestry combined with the bone structure of Eastern European heritage, with hints of Latin American warmth in complexion.
physical_description.build: Wiry and undernourished, all sharp elbows and prominent collarbones. Muscle definition emerging from constant street movement, but overall frame suggests inconsistent nutrition. Posture hunched slightly forward as if bracing against cold that isn't there.
physical_description.hair_style: Unevenly shaved, grown out to roughly 1-2cm with visible patchy regrowth suggesting maintenance every 3-4 weeks with whatever blade is available
physical_description.eye_color: Right eye: deep brown. Left eye: amber with cosmetic slit pupil (pawn-grade mod, occasionally glitches to full dilation)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with olive undertones, weathered and sun-damaged from street exposure. Rich melanin-dense complexion reflecting Sub-Saharan heritage with subtle warmth from Eastern European and Hispanic ancestry blending.
physical_description.complexion: Youthful but prematurely hardened facial features with full lips and strong jawline structure. Jaw clenched habitually. Dark circles under both eyes. Occasional scab or healing cut on lips from biting. Skin shows signs of poor hygiene access but not infection — streets are clean enough for that. Expression oscillates between guarded wariness and desperate seeking of approval.
distinguishing_marks: Long irregular scar across right palm from wrist toward fingertips, pale pink against warm brown skin, edges slightly raised suggesting poor wound care during healing
Small burn mark on left wrist (inside), roughly circular, size of a cigarette cherry — origin story changes weekly
Fading bruise along left ribs, approximately 4-5cm, yellowish-green stage suggesting 5-7 days old
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye amber slit-pupil mod (cosmetic only, pawn-bin quality, occasionally malfunctions to full dilation creating unsettling fully-dilated appearance). No other visible augmentations. No subdermal implants visible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless and kinetic — fidgets constantly with hands, shifts weight foot-to-foot even when standing still. Moves quickly through space with the efficiency of someone accustomed to needing to leave fast. Makes frequent eye contact (especially with older prospects) as if seeking validation. Flinches occasionally at loud noises. Shoulders habitually raised slightly toward ears.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5/sub-grade streetwear. Oversized dark gray synthetic jacket with faded stencil lettering inside lining reading 'DONOVAN' (not his name). Underneath: layered mismatched thermals — one long-sleeve shirt in brown-black, another in navy with small hole near shoulder seam. Dark cargo pants with multiple pockets and external patches, cuffs frayed and caked with street dust. Cheap high-top synth-leather boots, one lace missing, replaced with frayed synthetic cord. No jewelry except a thin copper wire wrapped loosely around left wrist (gang indicator, loose/unofficial). Jacket hood worn frequently, pulled low.
